```{r}
library(shiny)

# --- UI Definition ---
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Shorebird Data Entry"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      dateInput("date", "Survey Date:", value = Sys.Date(), format = "mm/dd/yyyy"),
      
      selectInput("zone", "Zone Class:",
                  choices = c("Select Zone", "I", "II", "III", "III Boulders", "III Rocky Outcrop")),
      
      selectInput("dataType", "Species:",
                  choices = c("Select Species", "People","Dogs on Leash", "Brown Pelican", "Cormorant","Great Blue Heron", "Great                               Egret", "Snowy Egret","Black-Bellied Plover", "Curlew",
                              "Willet", "Wandering Tattler", "Oystercatcher", "Spotted Sandpiper", "Marbled Godwit", 
                              "Whimbrel", "Ruddy Turnstone", "Black Turnstone", "Surfbird", 
                              "Sanderling", "Juvenile Gull", "Western Gull", "California Gull", 
                              "Heerman's Gull", "Herring Gull", "Tern", "Unidentified Gull", 
                              "Unidentified Bird (non-gull)", "Black Phoebe", "Say's Phoebe")),
      
      numericInput("dataCount", "Data Count:", value = 1, min = 1),
      
      actionButton("submit", "Submit Entry", class = "btn-primary"),
      actionButton("removeLast", "Remove Last Session Entry"),
      hr(),
      downloadButton("downloadData", "Download CSV (Session Data)")
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      wellPanel(
        span("Status: ", style = "font-weight: bold;"),
        textOutput("status", inline = TRUE)
      ),
      h4("Last 5 Entries (From CSV File):"),
      tableOutput("fileDataTable"),  # Shows data saved in the actual file
      hr(),
      h4("Current Session History:"),
      tableOutput("dataTable")      # Shows everything entered since opening the app
    )
  )
)

# --- Server Logic ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # 1. Path Setup EDIT THIS TO CORRECT FILE NAME
  csv_path <- file.path(".", "Data", "shorebird_2025_2026.csv")
  
  # 2. Reactive Values
  # data() stores session-only info
  data <- reactiveVal(data.frame(SurveyDate = character(),
                                 ZoneClass = character(),
                                 DataType = character(),
                                 DataCount = numeric(),
                                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  
  lastZone <- reactiveVal("Select Zone")
  
  # Trigger to refresh the 'Last 5' table from the file
  refresh_file_view <- reactiveVal(0)
  
  # 3. Submit Logic
  observeEvent(input$submit, {
    if (input$zone == "Select Zone" || input$dataType == "Select Species") {
      output$status <- renderText("Error: Please select a valid Zone and Species.")
      return()
    }
    
    # Create the new row
    new_entry <- data.frame(SurveyDate = format(input$date, "%m/%d/%Y"),
                            ZoneClass = as.character(input$zone),
                            DataType = input$dataType,
                            DataCount = as.numeric(input$dataCount),
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    # Update session data
    updated_session_data <- rbind(data(), new_entry)
    data(updated_session_data)
    
    # Write to CSV File (Append logic)
    tryCatch({
      if (file.exists(csv_path)) {
        write.table(new_entry, csv_path, sep = ",", col.names = FALSE, 
                    row.names = FALSE, append = TRUE, qmethod = "double")
      } else {
        write.table(new_entry, csv_path, sep = ",", col.names = TRUE, 
                    row.names = FALSE, append = FALSE, qmethod = "double")
      }
      output$status <- renderText(paste("Success! Entry saved to", csv_path))
      # Trigger the file table to refresh
      refresh_file_view(refresh_file_view() + 1)
    }, error = function(e) {
      output$status <- renderText("ERROR: Close the CSV file if it is open in another program!")
    })
    
    # Reset UI logic
    lastZone(input$zone)
    updateSelectInput(session, "dataType", selected = "Select Species")
    updateNumericInput(session, "dataCount", value = 1)
    updateSelectInput(session, "zone", selected = lastZone())
  })
  
  # 4. Remove Last Entry (Session only)
  observeEvent(input$removeLast, {
    current_data <- data()
    if (nrow(current_data) > 0) {
      data(current_data[-nrow(current_data), ])
      output$status <- renderText("Last entry removed from session view.")
    }
  })
  
  # 5. Table: Last 5 Entries FROM FILE
  output$fileDataTable <- renderTable({
    refresh_file_view() # Refresh whenever a new entry is submitted
    
    if (file.exists(csv_path)) {
      file_data <- read.csv(csv_path)
      # Grab last 5, reverse to show newest on top
      display_df <- tail(file_data, 5)
      return(display_df[rev(seq_len(nrow(display_df))), ])
    } else {
      return(data.frame(Message = "No data found in file yet."))
    }
  }, rownames = FALSE)
  
  # 6. Table: All Session History
  output$dataTable <- renderTable({
    data()
  }, rownames = TRUE)
  
  # 7. Download Handler
  output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste("session_backup_", Sys.Date(), ".csv", sep = "") },
    content = function(file) { write.csv(data(), file, row.names = FALSE) }
  )
}

# --- Run App ---
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

```
